name: Omori
tagline: Shinagawa in 9 minutes and Tokyo in 23 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, where JR East run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 30 minutes to Shinjuku, 25 minutes to Shibuya and 9 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 6.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 6.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.7 m to 16.7 m, a difference of 15.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is いすゞ病院, about 7 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 中島病院, about 15 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Omorikaigan is ahead on quiet, but Omori is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Omori. Omorikaigan has the Keikyu Main Line, a different set from Omori. To Shinjuku, for instance, Omorikaigan takes 12 minutes longer. A one-room flat costs about ¥7,000 more at Omorikaigan. On the number of places to eat out, Omori comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Heiwajima is ahead on quiet, but Omori is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Omori in a straight line. Heiwajima has the Keikyu Main Line, a different set from Omori. To Shinjuku, for instance, Heiwajima takes 14 minutes longer. On the number of places to eat out, Omori comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 池上通り (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the JR Keihin-Tohoku Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
